## Tours with Iguazu Falls and Macuco Safari: panoramic views and a boat ride

On the Brazilian side of Iguazu, you can see the network of cascades from viewing platforms and then approach the falling water by boat. The [excursion with an English-speaking guide and Macuco Safari](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/brazilian-iguazu-waterfalls-macuco-english/) combines both experiences: walking to viewpoints in the national park and taking a separate boat excursion. The program includes the guide, entrance tickets and Macuco Safari.

We have gathered {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} featuring this exact excursion module. The purpose of this catalog is to help you choose **a tour that includes the activity**, rather than a standalone boat ticket. The total trip duration, other cities, hotels and flight arrangements depend on the particular itinerary.

## How the view from above differs from the boat ride

The viewpoints in Brazil's national park offer a sweeping panorama of the waterfalls. From land, you can appreciate the length of the cascades and the arrangement of individual streams. Macuco Safari adds a boat trip along the river toward the falls, taking passengers much closer to the spray and the roar of the water.

The independent Macuco Safari operator offers several services and its own tickets. The [Ada Tours excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/brazilian-iguazu-waterfalls-macuco-english/) includes sightseeing on the Brazilian side, the boat ride and English-speaking guiding. Rafting, helicopter flights or other activities in the operator's range should not automatically be assumed to be included.

A visit to the [Argentine side of Iguazu](/argentina/place/puerto-iguazu/) is a different experience again, with paths and routes inside the neighboring national park. Argentina is visited only when expressly included in the chosen tour; the Macuco Safari excursion does not imply a border crossing.

## How Macuco Safari fits into a group tour of Brazil

On the [nine-day “Rio – Iguazu – São Paulo” tour](/brazil/tour/rio-iguazu-sao-paulo-group-9-days/), this excursion takes place on day six. Before reaching Iguazu, the group spends several days in [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) and then flies to the waterfalls. After the excursion, the journey continues to [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/).

This arrangement combines city experiences with natural scenery without making the entire holiday a trip solely to the waterfalls. It suits groups interested in Rio's famous sights, Iguazu's landscapes and the metropolis of São Paulo, rather than only the boat ride.

For the tour described, the excursion guide speaks English, and entrance tickets and Macuco Safari are listed as part of day six. The tour is designed for a group, with accommodation terms and pricing linked to group size. **The Macuco Safari operator's ticket price is not the cost of the entire tour** and does not replace its commercial quotation.

## Weather, water levels and practical preparation

The waterfalls are on a river, so excursion conditions depend on weather and water levels. During heavy rain, flooding or changes to safety rules, some viewing areas and river activities may operate differently for a time. Before departure, confirm current access and boat-trip conditions with the operator, especially if you are traveling during a period of high river flow.

Wear shoes with good grip and protect your personal belongings from water. Going close to the cascades means spray, so waterproof storage for phones and documents is advisable. Boarding restrictions, admission of children and passengers with reduced mobility must be checked against the operator's current rules. Inclusion of an excursion in a tour does not waive safety requirements.

When coordinating a journey through Ada Tours, allow a reasonable interval between the river activity, ground transfers and any onward flight. The excursion start time, available windows and boat availability need to fit the group's actual schedule.

## Comparing tours that include Macuco Safari

Check four things when choosing an itinerary:

- **Is the boat section actually included?** A visit to the Brazilian viewpoints alone and an excursion including Macuco Safari are different products.
- **Which guiding language is specified?** English is stated for [this excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/brazilian-iguazu-waterfalls-macuco-english/) and the [nine-day itinerary](/brazil/tour/rio-iguazu-sao-paulo-group-9-days/).
- **How much time is allocated to Iguazu?** On a tour visiting several cities, the arrival day, excursion day and subsequent journey all matter.
- **Is the second national park included?** The Brazilian boat trip does not mean a visit to the Argentine side. For both sides, compare itineraries and the [geography of Puerto Iguazu](/argentina/place/puerto-iguazu/).

Travelers particularly interested in nature and active outings can also explore [adventure journeys](/interests/adventure/) and [nature-focused itineraries](/interests/wildlife/). However, the specific combination of Brazilian viewpoints, Macuco Safari and an English-speaking guide is confirmed by the description of the selected excursion.

## Frequently asked questions about tours with Macuco Safari

### Is Macuco Safari included in the nine-day Rio – Iguazu – São Paulo tour?

Yes. On the [nine-day itinerary](/brazil/tour/rio-iguazu-sao-paulo-group-9-days/), the excursion to the Brazilian waterfalls with Macuco Safari is scheduled for day six. Its excursion module also specifies an English-speaking guide and tickets.

### Is this the same excursion as visiting the Argentine side of Iguazu?

No. Macuco Safari operates on the Brazilian side of the waterfalls. Visiting the Argentine park requires a separate route, enough time and a check of border-crossing requirements.

### Can the boat ride be replaced with a helicopter flight?

A helicopter flight is not included in the confirmed excursion module. Any substitution or additional activity must be agreed separately according to the available product and the particular tour itinerary.

### What happens when water levels are high?

The operator and park authorities may introduce temporary safety restrictions. Changes to the program or compensation are governed by the terms of the particular trip; the boat section cannot be guaranteed in all weather.

### Do I need to buy a Macuco Safari ticket separately?

The [description of the selected Ada Tours excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/brazilian-iguazu-waterfalls-macuco-english/) lists tickets and the boat program as included. When booking a specific tour, check that this excursion remains part of the agreed services.

## Iguazu Bird Park: visiting as part of a combined itinerary

The [Bird Park](/brazil/place/parque-das-aves/) lies beside Brazil's Iguazu National Park, near [Foz do Iguaçu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/). It is a place to discover the birds of the Atlantic Forest: visitors follow pathways through vegetation and watch birds in spacious aviaries.

We offer a visit to the Bird Park as part of a private itinerary. **On this day, we combine the Bird Park with the Brazilian waterfalls and Macuco Safari.** Time is divided among these activities. A separate six-hour excursion devoted solely to the Bird Park is not offered under this program.

## What makes the Bird Park interesting?

The park carries out substantial conservation work: protecting Atlantic Forest birds, caring for them, delivering educational programs and restoring habitats. A visit differs from watching wild birds in a forest. Here it is easier to observe plumage, beak shapes and behavior in a managed environment, although seeing any particular individual depends on animal care and the park's operating arrangements.

Recognizable birds from the region include toucans, macaws and other tropical species. The visit should be approached as an opportunity to learn about nature and conservation, not as a promise of a close-up photograph of a particular animal.

## Why it makes sense to combine the park with the waterfalls

The Bird Park is next to one of the main entrances to the Brazilian national park. When planning your day, there is therefore no need to travel across the entire city between the two sites. The precise order, however, depends on your agreed excursion, visitor numbers and the departure time for Macuco Safari.

Our excursion day brings together **three different experiences**: waterfall panoramas, a walk among birds and the Macuco Safari water activity. The latter is not part of the Bird Park itself. Entrance tickets, transfers and time to change after the boat ride should be considered separately in advance.

## What to check when choosing a program

| Question | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Time in the park | Depends on the whole day's schedule |
| Entrance ticket | Must be confirmed for the package |
| Transfers | Depend on the route |
| Activities | The boat ride is separate |

For this visit, **no separate price, guaranteed duration or list of included tickets is specified**. The park's presence in an excursion day does not automatically mean all related services are paid for in every other tour. Check the conditions of the exact product you select.

For longer journeys, consider the [“Chile and Argentina: Grand Tour with Iguazu”](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/), whose itinerary includes the park. The [Foz do Iguaçu page](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) explains the geography of the Brazilian side, while trips through natural landscapes are collected under [Nature](/interests/nature/). Watching birds in the park's aviaries and the Macuco Safari water activity are different from observing wild animals in their natural habitat.

## Tips for walking among the birds

Lightweight closed shoes, water and weather-appropriate clothing are useful on the park paths. Rain and high humidity are common in the subtropical Iguazu region, so protect electronic devices from water. Stay on the paths, follow staff instructions, do not feed the birds or approach them against the rules. Avoid harsh camera flashes that might disturb the animals.

## Frequently asked questions about Iguazu Bird Park

### Are the Bird Park and Macuco Safari one excursion?

No. They are different activities within a single excursion day. The park focuses on birds and conservation work; Macuco Safari is a separate water activity.

### Can you spend six hours in the Bird Park?

Ada Tours does not advertise a separate six-hour visit under this published offer. Time is shared among the park, the waterfalls and Macuco Safari.

### Is the park entrance ticket included?

The tickets included are not specified in this excursion module. Confirm them in the terms of the main tour or an agreed separate program.

## Why include the Bird Park in a private Iguazu itinerary?

The [Bird Park](/brazil/place/parque-das-aves/) is in [Foz do Iguaçu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/), beside the entrance to the Brazilian side of the waterfalls. Between panoramic views of the enormous cascades and a walk among tropical birds, visitors can experience two sides of the Atlantic Forest. The park has maintained paths and large aviaries, including areas where guests follow a route among the birds.

For travelers spending only a few days at Iguazu, combining activities in a single itinerary can be more useful than a separate long outing. It is essential, however, to check exactly which activities are included in a particular tour. **A group sightseeing excursion to the waterfalls, a standalone six-hour Bird Park excursion and a Bird Park visit within a private day are three different Ada Tours products.**

## The excursion day on the 17-day grand tour

On the current [“Chile and Argentina: 17-Day Grand Tour with Iguazu in Brazil”](/multi-country/tour/chile-argentina-private-grand-tour-17-days/), the Bird Park visit is included in a combined day on the Brazilian side of the falls. A panoramic excursion to the cascades and [Macuco Safari](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/macuco-safari-group-add-on/) are also scheduled that day, and the bird park visit is arranged around the timing of those two activities.

Before arriving at Iguazu, travelers explore Chile and Argentina; the itinerary includes Atacama, Patagonia, Mendoza and other stops. On day thirteen, the program provides for a flight from Mendoza to the waterfalls by private jet, followed by accommodation on the Brazilian side. This is an important feature of **this particular 17-day product**. The same condition must not be assumed for other tours that include the Bird Park.

The following day focuses on Brazilian Iguazu panoramas, a nature walk and birds. When planning, it helps to decide in advance what matters most that day: leisurely birdwatching, waterfall viewing platforms or the boat ride. The duration of each element is agreed within the whole day's schedule; **a separate six-hour Bird Park excursion is not specified for this tour**.

## What you will see in the Bird Park

The official Parque das Aves route follows a maintained path approximately 2 km long. Visitors can explore immersive aviaries, watch toucans, parrots, macaws and other Atlantic Forest residents, and read about the conservation of local species. This experience differs from watching wild birds in a forest, as many of the birds live in dedicated park environments.

The [official Iguazu nature park](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) and Parque das Aves are close together, but have separate entrances, operations and tickets. Their proximity makes a combined day possible; it does not mean that one ticket automatically pays for both attractions.

## Who is this format for?

| Option | Main feature |
|---|---|
| Private Iguazu day | Bird Park together with waterfalls and Macuco |
| [Six-hour Bird Park tour](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/) | Standalone excursion product |
| [Group waterfall walk with a Russian-speaking guide](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-brazil-group-russian-program/) | Focus on the Brazilian cascades |

A combined private day suits travelers who want to discover Iguazu's birdlife without missing the main viewpoints and other activities. Those wishing to photograph birds at a relaxed pace should allow more time in the park and agree which other parts of the day can be shortened.

Do not confuse these products with the standalone [six-hour Bird Park excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/). Its price, transfers and guiding apply only to that separate excursion. They do not become the price or an additional charge for the 17-day grand tour.

## What to keep in mind before traveling

Iguazu's tropical climate can be hot and humid; closed footwear, water and protection from sun or rain are useful on the trails. Within the Bird Park, visitors must not touch the birds and must follow staff instructions. If photography time is important, discuss the length of the visit in advance.

This catalog shows only tours with **this specific excursion module in the program**. Two excursions visiting the same site are not necessarily the same service. Check the product name, excursion day and included services directly in your chosen tour.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_chile_argentina_private_grand_tour_17_days}}

## Frequently asked questions about the Bird Park on a private tour

### Can you see the Bird Park and the waterfalls on the same day?

Yes. Parque das Aves lies beside the national park entrance, and the visits are combined on the private tour described. Actual timing depends on the day's itinerary and agreed order.

### Does the Bird Park visit necessarily last six hours?

No. Six hours refers to [another standalone excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/). On a private tour, time at the Bird Park is coordinated with the panoramic viewpoints and Macuco Safari.

### Does this include the Russian-speaking group excursion?

That is not stated in this private excursion module. A Russian-speaking group guide is offered for [a separate program on the Brazilian side](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-brazil-group-russian-program/); the language and services of this specific grand tour should be checked in its own description.

## Iguazu Bird Park: an excursion to see toucans and parrots

The [Iguazu Bird Park](/brazil/place/parque-das-aves/) (Parque das Aves) is in Foz do Iguaçu, beside the entrance to the waterfalls' national park. Here you can see toucans, colorful parrots and other Atlantic Forest birds, as well as learn about efforts to protect rare species.

Ada Tours offers a [“Bird Park in Iguazu” excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/) lasting **6 hours**. It is an introduction to birds and tropical nature that can be enjoyed on its own or as part of a journey to the waterfalls.

## What is Parque das Aves?

It is a conservation center working with species from Brazil's Atlantic Forest. The park's official website emphasizes assistance for rescued animals, research, environmental education and habitat restoration.

Visitors follow a maintained route among trees and aviaries. According to the park, the self-guided walking path is approximately **2 km** long. Some areas allow close observation of birds, but touching the animals is prohibited.

It is important to distinguish the park's own visitor experience from Ada Tours' product. The public route through Parque das Aves can be completed independently, while our excursion includes transfers and a guide. These represent different levels of service.

## Which birds might you see?

### Toucans

Toucans are known for their large, brightly colored bills. Visitors come to the park to observe their distinctive plumage and behavior at close range. When taking photographs, choose a calm moment, do not lure birds with food and avoid flash wherever it is prohibited.

### Macaws and other parrots

Large macaws are among the most recognizable groups of birds in tropical South America. Parque das Aves has an area dedicated to watching them, while other displays feature smaller parrots.

### Hummingbirds and forest birds

The park has areas introducing visitors to hummingbirds, as well as species associated with rivers, mangroves and different levels of the forest. The mix of animals and availability of particular areas can change according to care requirements, so a precise species list cannot be guaranteed for a particular date.

## How much time is needed?

Our excursion lasts **6 hours**. This refers to the full excursion product, not a promise that walking in the park itself takes six hours. On an independent visit, the time required depends on your pace, stops and interest in observing the birds.

Paths within the park have relatively level surfaces. Nevertheless, humidity and heat may call for breaks, especially when visiting with children or people who find standing for long periods difficult. Rest areas are available, although access to individual parts should be checked with the park.

## Price and included services

Our excursion costs **$51 per person**, with a possible discount for two or more participants. **Transfers and a guide** are included. Whether the park entrance ticket is included is not separately confirmed, so check the ticket and other expenses when booking.

Current visiting arrangements at Parque das Aves, its own ticket prices, group requirements and aviary availability should be checked on the official park website closer to the date of the trip.

## Bird Park and Iguazu Falls: combining the visits

Parque das Aves is beside the Brazilian side of [Iguazu Falls](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/). This makes it possible to visit both sites on the same day if time is planned appropriately. Proximity alone does not mean waterfall tickets, walks along the waterfall trails or every transport service are included in the bird park excursion described here.

The park and the waterfalls offer different experiences: the birds of the Atlantic Forest and conservation work at the former, and enormous cascades and panoramic platforms at the latter. A fuller visit to both sides of the international border may require another day and a planned transfer.

The park is included in various Brazil itineraries, and the [Brazil tours catalog](/brazil/tour/) allows you to compare duration, main countries and accommodation. For multi-country journeys, check separately whether the Argentine side of the waterfalls is included.

## Preparing for the excursion

Wear comfortable shoes and bring drinking water, sun protection and a light raincoat. The Atlantic Forest around Iguazu is humid, and rain is possible throughout the year. When watching birds, respect staff instructions, do not feed animals and stay on the designated path.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is the Bird Park?

In Foz do Iguaçu, near the Brazilian entrance to Iguazu Falls.

### How long is the Ada Tours excursion?

Our excursion lasts **6 hours**; an independent walk through the park may take a different amount of time.

### What is included?

Transfers and a guide are included. Entrance-ticket arrangements and any additional costs must be clarified separately.

### Can you visit the park and waterfalls on the same day?

Yes. The sites are close together. Agree the order in advance and make sure both visits are included in your actual booking.

## Six hours at the Bird Park: what the excursion name means

[Iguazu Bird Park](/brazil/place/parque-das-aves/) lies in Foz do Iguaçu, next to Brazil's Iguazu Falls National Park. Visitors walk along maintained paths through tropical vegetation and large aviaries. Here they can see toucans, macaws, parrots, hummingbirds, herons and other birds, and learn about conservation of Atlantic Forest species.

The standalone [“Iguazu Bird Park” excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/) lasts **six hours**. This is the duration of the whole tourist product, including transfers and guiding, and does not imply six hours of continuous walking through the aviaries. Transfers and a guide are included.

Here you will find {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} featuring this excursion module. Its presence in an itinerary does not automatically establish that it is already covered by the price of every tour: paid additions and the composition of the main program vary.

## Types of tours that visit the Bird Park

On the [14-day Brazil itinerary](/multi-country/tour/brazil-rio-ouro-preto-salvador-praia-do-forte-iguazu-14-days/), the excursion comes after visits to Rio, historic Ouro Preto, Salvador and the Praia do Forte coast. Iguazu Falls forms part of the final stage of the journey. This option suits those who want to experience several cultural regions of the country before visiting the waterfalls and birds.

On the [12-day São Paulo – Iguazu – Rio – Ilha Grande – Paraty itinerary](/multi-country/tour/brazil-sao-paulo-iguazu-rio-ilha-grande-paraty-12-days/), the Bird Park belongs to the stop at the waterfalls, after which the journey continues through other parts of Brazil. The same canonical excursion product is used in the excursion block, but the overall schedule, flights and overnight stays are different.

On the [“Luxury Brazil” journey](/multi-country/tour/luxury-brazil/), the Bird Park is also connected to the Iguazu Falls stop. The tour's name does not change the price, duration or services of the standalone excursion; accommodation standards and conditions for the whole journey should be read on the chosen tour's page.

There are also programs focusing on Iguazu itself, including a [three-day wedding itinerary](/brazil/tour/iguazu-falls-wedding/). Its romantic format differs substantially from a sightseeing journey through several cities. A shared excursion link does not make these products interchangeable.

## Price of the standalone excursion versus the tour price

Under the current description, the standalone excursion costs **$51 per person**, with a possible discount for two or more participants. These are the terms of this six-hour offer, not an advertised participation price for a multi-day tour.

The standalone offer lists transfers and a guide. For each journey, check whether the excursion module is included in the paid package, whether it is optional and which restrictions apply on the travel date. Do not mechanically add $51 to every tour on the list or treat that figure as the final cost of the journey.

| Question | What to check |
|---|---|
| Duration | Six hours for the standalone excursion |
| Price | $51 per person for the excursion |
| Tour package | Inclusions and surcharges in the tour |
| Other activities | Waterfalls and the day's other excursions |

## What happens during the walk?

According to Parque das Aves itself, the standard visitor route follows a path approximately **2 km** long through immersive aviaries. Visitors should not touch birds and must follow staff instructions. The park's conservation and educational programs explain why protecting the Atlantic Forest matters to local species.

This is birdwatching in a specialized park, not a promise that every listed species will be seen in the wild. Photography enthusiasts may want to agree separately on the pace and time available for stops.

The [Bird Park](/brazil/place/parque-das-aves/) and [Iguazu Falls](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) are nearby and are therefore often combined in one excursion day. They remain separate sites with their own visiting conditions, however. [Macuco Safari](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/macuco-safari-group-add-on/) is a different service and is added only when confirmed in the program.

## Choosing the format you need

If you want a standalone excursion with the stated duration and price, look for [“Iguazu Bird Park: 6 Hours”](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-tour-6-hours/). If you want to include a shorter bird park stop between the waterfalls and a boat trip, explore the [visit within a private itinerary](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-bird-park-private-program-visit/). If your priority is a group visit to the cascades with a Russian-speaking guide, that is [a separate Brazilian-side excursion](/brazil/foz-do-iguacu/iguazu-brazil-group-russian-program/).

## Frequently asked questions about the six-hour Bird Park excursion

### How much does the standalone excursion cost?

Ada Tours' published description specifies **$51 per person**, with a possible discount for two or more participants. This rate applies to the excursion, not to all the tours featuring it.

### Are transfers and a guide included?

Yes, both are expressly listed in the terms of the standalone excursion. On a multi-day trip, the services included must be checked in that particular tour's description.

### Can the Bird Park be combined with the waterfalls?

Yes. The Bird Park is next to the national park. For a combined day, agree the duration of all sections and the ticket arrangements in advance.
